limitations: Producer QA only: public read-only smoke hooks and one pure collision helper supply browser inputs; they are not an independent concept verifier.
TypeSafe/Jev semantic prerequisite is missing; no model was called. Pixels and producer pass fields do not establish semantic verification or mastery.
Raw evidence is retained for a separate verifier; this run writes no receipt, learner state, commit, push, deployment, or production data.

Prior probes are retained: warehouse canvas isVisible was an invalid extra observer assertion; Task Forge L1 distractor selections did not guarantee failure under its 80% threshold. The current observer requires unavailable WebGL plus a visible playable accessible projection, and uses explicit L3 retry-vs-DLQ misclassification for Task Forge's negative/retry case.

Pointer action timeout is bounded at 10 seconds; each solver loop is bounded at 45 seconds/160 iterations. A timeout without a failed producer record remains observer/runtime uncertainty, not a product defect.
This invocation deliberately selects a subset; it cannot qualify all 17 games.
Parent-authorized resumed sweep stopped by its 1-minute host load >60 watchdog after 170862ms. No game11–18 started, no product failure inferred from this stop.
Hash Ring emitted captured passing records for L1–L4 but remains incomplete at the game packet boundary; captured cases are retained separately and not counted as completed qualification.
